title: More Vacation, Less Calculation: Maximizing Hilton Honors Points at All-Inclusive Resorts
summary: At Hilton's all‑inclusive resorts, redeeming Points for a stay means travelers can spend less time calculating costs and more time enjoying the moment.
body_markdown:
Listen to this article


0:00


- **From beachfront escapes in Mexico to Caribbean retreats, Hilton Honors helps members turn all-inclusive stays into seamless getaways, with reward stays starting at 51,000 Points.**
- **At Hilton's all-inclusive resorts, redeeming Points for a stay means accommodations, dining, drinks and more are already included, so travelers can spend less time calculating costs and more time enjoying the moment.**
- **Hilton Honors benefits, like no blackout dates, waived resort fees and Fifth Night Free on reward stays, can help members stretch their Points even further.**


Planning a vacation often comes with a familiar balancing act: choosing the destination, setting a budget and finding ways to make every moment count once you arrive. For travelers looking for simplicity,[Hilton’s all-inclusive portfolio](https://www.hilton.com/en/all-inclusive/?msockid=2a068db50891676409789a29095c669d) helps streamline that experience by bringing more of the vacation – and more of the costs – into one stay.


***This article is part of "Point Taken," a Stories From Hilton series that takes a closer look at Hilton Honors, the award-winning guest loyalty program.***


## One Redemption, One Well-Rounded Vacation


For many travelers, maximizing Points is about understanding how much a redemption can help cover. With countless[inclusions available at Hilton's all-inclusive resorts](https://www.hilton.com/en/all-inclusive/what-is-included/?msockid=360ff0e0dd016d912f77e61fdc8b6cb2) , members can enjoy a wide range of experiences throughout a single stay without needing to plan around each additional expense.


Hilton Vallarta Riviera All-Inclusive Resort


## Built-In Benefits for Better Stays


Beyond redeeming Points for a stay, Hilton Honors offers members benefits designed to enhance every stage of the travel journey, from planning and arrival to time spent at the resort. For example, at booking, the Points & Money feature allows members to combine nearly any combination of Points and cash when booking a stay.


As the stay nears, elite members look forward to the possibility of space-available room upgrades. Before, during and after the trip, through the Hilton Honors App, members can track their reservations, Points and tier progression.


During the stay, members can choose their room and use (and share) Digital Key at participating properties. Eligible Silver, Gold, Diamond and Diamond Reserve Hilton Honors members can also enjoy a 15% discount on single spa treatments at all-inclusive resorts.


Hilton Cancun Mar Caribe All-Inclusive Resort


## From Family Getaways to Beachfront Retreats: Endless Ways to Escape


Hilton's growing portfolio of all-inclusive resorts gives members countless ways to turn Points into memorable travel experiences for all occasions.


For families, Hilton Honors Points can unlock getaways designed with every generation in mind. Starting at just 100,000 Points per night,[Hilton Cancun Mar Caribe All-Inclusive Resort](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/cunmchh-hilton-cancun-mar-caribe-all-inclusive-resort/) and[Hilton Cancun, an All-Inclusive Resort](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/cunqrhh-hilton-cancun/) offer a range of experiences for travelers. At Hilton Cancun Mar Caribe, guests can spend the day splashing across 13 pools, while teens can enjoy their own space at Sandbar Social. Meanwhile, Hilton Cancun’s outdoor activity park can keep kids entertained all day, giving adults time to take advantage of the resort’s wellness amenities, creating a vacation that feels rewarding for everyone.


Hilton Cancun, an All-Inclusive Resort


Travelers looking to blend relaxation with destination-inspired experiences can redeem Points for stays at[Hilton Vallarta Riviera All-Inclusive Resort](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/pvrpahh-hilton-vallarta-riviera-all-inclusive-resort/?WT.mc_id=zlada0ww1hi2psh3ggl4advbpp5dkt6multibr7_153669424_1003528&gclsrc=aw.ds&gad_source=1&gad_campaignid=23557468764&gbraid=0AAAAADOglH2JsrI4SnOb11NY0RJl2Ly6q&gclid=Cj0KCQjwlqTRBhCBARIsANrkrxg8cCITLiqNuKN67qppeNlUyJn_lF2kxdo-Zimm8yLrzSqz63nmWtIaAiA-EALw_wcB) for as little as 80,000 Points per night. Nestled between the Sierra Madre mountains and a secluded beachfront, the resort invites guests to experience the spirit of Puerto Vallarta through activities that go beyond the beach, whether they are joining a wellness or culinary class, relaxing by the oceanfront pools or enjoying live performances throughout the stay. With options ranging from tequila tastings for adults and pizza workshops for kids, there’s something new for everyone in the group to enjoy.


For those seeking a Caribbean beach getaway,[Mangrove Beach Corendon Curaçao All-Inclusive Resort, Curio Collection by Hilton](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/curryqq-mangrove-beach-corendon-curacao-all-inclusive-resort/?msockid=2a068db50891676409789a29095c669d) and[Zemi Miches Punta Cana All-Inclusive Resort, Curio Collection by Hilton](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/pujmiqq-zemi-miches-all-inclusive-resort/?msockid=2a068db50891676409789a29095c669d) offer a range of included dining and beverage experiences, with reward stays starting at just 98,000 Points per night. Whether sipping a cocktail at the swim-up Coco Pool Bar in Curaçao or discovering Caribbean flavors at Toa in Zemi Miches, members can enjoy distinctive culinary experiences as part of their stay.


With a growing collection of all-inclusive resorts, Hilton Honors members have more ways than ever to turn their Points into the vacation that best fits their travel style. By pairing the convenience of an all-inclusive stay with the flexibility of Hilton Honors, members can make the most of their Points while enjoying a seamless getaway from start to finish.


Zemi Miches Punta Cana All-Inclusive Resort, Curio Collection by Hilton


## More Vacation, Less Calculation


For many travelers, the best vacations are the ones that feel simple from the start. That simplicity is especially meaningful when a trip is booked with Points, giving Hilton Honors members a clearer sense of what their redemption can help cover before they arrive.


Instead of constantly calculating what each meal, drink or activity might add to the vacation budget, members can focus on enjoying the experience as it unfolds. With more of the vacation built into the all-inclusive stay, a Points redemption can help members spend less time adding up expenses and more time making the most of their stay.


##### FAQ: Maximizing Hilton Honors Points at All-Inclusive Resorts


Yes. Hilton Honors members can redeem Points for stays at participating all-inclusive resorts.


While offerings vary by property, redemptions generally include accommodations and many on-property dining, beverage and entertainment experiences.


No. Hilton Honors offers no blackout dates for standard room reward stays when a standard room is available.


No. Resort fees are waived on reward stays booked entirely with Hilton Honors Points.


Eligible Hilton Honors elite members receive every fifth night free on standard room reward stays, up to the program limits.


Travelers can explore Hilton's full portfolio of all-inclusive resorts, including destinations across Mexico and the Caribbean, at[Hilton All-Inclusive Resorts and Vacation Hotels.](https://www.hilton.com/en/all-inclusive/?msockid=2a068db50891676409789a29095c669d)


The redemption rates featured in this article are starting-from rates and may vary by travel date, room type, season and availability. For the latest rates and availability, visit[Hilton.com](https://www.hilton.com/en/) or the[Hilton Honors App](https://www.hilton.com/en/p/hilton-honors-mobile-app/) .


Point redemption rates for reward stays may vary and are influenced by a variety of factors, including travel dates, availability, room type, special events and the size of the travel party. The points required for a stay are displayed at the time of booking. For complete details, please refer to the[Hilton Honors Terms & Conditions](https://www.hilton.com/en/hilton-honors/terms/?msockid=2a068db50891676409789a29095c669d) .
